author: nflaig
content:
eg. something like this
```python
def is_optimistic(opt_store: OptimisticStore, store: Store, node: ForkChoiceNode) -> bool:
      assert node.payload_status in [PAYLOAD_STATUS_EMPTY, PAYLOAD_STATUS_FULL]
      bid = store.blocks[node.root].body.signed_execution_payload_bid.message
      if node.payload_status == PAYLOAD_STATUS_FULL:
          payload_hash = bid.block_hash
      else:
          payload_hash = bid.parent_block_hash
      return get_payload_status(opt_store, payload_hash) == NOT_VALIDATED
```
